citations.description: Ticket f81d-bab0-3938-4f1c status field: 'in_progress' — not closed or won't-fix, despite the closing comment asserting 'CLOSING AS WONT-FIX'.

findings.criterion: If the measured saving does NOT justify a CachePoint migration plus a shared-prefix redesign, the correct outcome is to CLOSE THIS AS WON'T-FIX with the measurement recorded.
findings.detail: The ticket's closing comment explicitly invokes this criterion and declares 'CLOSING AS WONT-FIX', but the ticket system status remains 'in_progress' — it has not actually been transitioned to a closed/won't-fix state. The criterion requires the ticket to be closed, not merely for a comment to assert closure.
findings.remediation: Transition the ticket status to 'closed' (or the equivalent won't-fix state) in the ticket system. The measurement is already recorded in the Phase 2 comment; only the status transition is missing.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
